channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue

item.title: NASA ramps up support to get Boeing's astronaut capsule flying after Butch and Suni fiasco
item.description: NASA is throwing extra support and money behind Boeing's troubled astronaut capsule to get it fixed and flying again as soon as possible

item.title: Andrew Bailey, an FBI deputy director, says he's leaving the post after just over a year in the job
item.description: Andrew Bailey, one of the FBI’s two deputy directors, says he is leaving the position after just over a year on the job and will be returning to Missouri to spend time with his family

item.title: Man gets 6 years in prison for taking explosives to church hosting annual Red Mass for justices
item.description: A New Jersey man has been sentenced to nearly six years in prison for taking homemade explosive devices to a Washington, D.C., church that was preparing for an annual Mass celebrating the start of the Supreme Court’s term

item.title: NHL players who took long contracts before salaries skyrocketed shake off signer's remorse
item.description: Many NHL players who signed long-term contracts before this past summer of high spending suddenly look underpaid

item.title: Case Keenum drives Chicago to 3 touchdowns as the Bears beat the Eagles 27-7
item.description: Case Keenum passed for two touchdowns in his first start in almost three years, and the Chicago Bears shut down Jalen Hurts and the Philadelphia Eagles for a 27-7 victory

item.title: Case Keenum starts at quarterback for the Bears against the Eagles
item.description: Case Keenum started at quarterback for the Chicago Bears against Philadelphia, his first regular-season game in almost three years

item.title: Questions surround counterterror probe into US air base after suspects were freed on bail
item.description: The U.K.'s counterterror police have released five suspects on bail during an investigation into a suspected bomb plot targeting a U.S.-operated air force base in England

item.title: Seoul demands an apology after Zelenskyy reveals North Korean POWs were sent to South Korea
item.description: Seoul has demanded an apology after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy revealed what it says was supposed to be a secret transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea

item.title: Estonia blames Russia for arson attack on defense company that provides vehicles to Ukraine
item.description: Estonian authorities say they have concluded that an arson attack in mid-August on a defense company that provides military vehicles to Ukraine was an act of sabotage commissioned by Russian security services

item.title: US and China release $60 billion nonsensitive product lists for tariff cuts after Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: The United States and China have released lists of products worth about $30 billion each that will see tariff cuts

item.title: Trump administration lowers fuel economy standards, critics say at a significant environmental cost
item.description: The Trump administration released new fuel economy standards on Monday, relaxing regulatory requirements for automakers to control pollution from gasoline-powered cars and light trucks

item.title: From motorcycles to booze, US ban on $1 billion worth of Canadian imports goes into effect
item.description: U.S.-Canada relations, already tense, are likely to deteriorate further after the United States went ahead early Tuesday with a decision to ban nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports, including alcoholic beverages, dairy products and motorcycles

item.title: Nvidia's board increases chipmaker's share buyback plan by $150 billion
item.description: Nvidia’s board has cleared the way for the company to spend $150 billion more in share buybacks as the chipmaking giant looks to make use of more of its stellar revenue growth fueled by demand for its high-end artificial intelligence chips

item.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces new safety pressures
item.description: OpenAI says it is delaying the release of a new artificial intelligence model out of security concerns voiced by its researchers, the latest in the company’s effort to decelerate the pace of the technology’s advance

item.title: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue
item.description: Nvidia has unveiled a new security platform designed to prevent AI agents from going rogue
